title: RADAR: Raman spectral Analysis using Deep learning for Artifact Removal (Python package)
description:
RADAR is a Python package that splits Raman spectra into four additive components — baseline, cosmic rays, noise and peaks — with convolutional neural networks.

  • Two pre-trained networks (standard and ensemble), each trained on 240 million synthetic spectra.
  • A synthetic data generator, training and fine-tuning routines, and evaluation metrics (RMSE, MAE, max error, R²).
  • File input/output for the common Raman formats: SPC, JCAMP-DX, Renishaw WDF, Horiba LabSpec, TriVista, instrument text exports, Excel, Parquet, SQLite, HDF5, MATLAB, JSON and NumPy.
  • A command-line tool, tests, examples and a user guide.

The networks, the synthetic data generator and the pre-trained weights come from the original implementation by Joel Sjöberg. Install with pip install radar-raman.
